top_choice_rationale: Buchwald and Hartwig independently made amine arylation a general, mechanism-driven palladium-catalysed reaction, with more than two decades of confirmation and daily use in discovery and process chemistry. The two-name allocation is clean and the citation can be worded around general catalytic C-N coupling, which separates it from the 2010 C-C prize and makes no priority ruling on Kosugi's stoichiometric tin chemistry. P001 is scientifically original and a close second, but its three-name cap omits Ciulli, Sakamoto, Gray, Ito or Kim and the bifunctional half has no approved drug, so I rank it below the settled discovery. Either award is preferable to no award.
